name: open-ALERT
tagline: A configurator for ALERT and ALERT2 flood-warning sites: say what a site must do, see the hardware that fits, its costs and consequences.
about: For anyone planning ALERT or ALERT2 field stations, repeaters or base stations. Each site goes from needs to requirements to hardware picked from a 252-part catalogue (open and closed, Raspberry Pi to industrial), then to a bill of materials, a power budget with battery and panel sized, labour and running costs, and the consequences of the choices. The Network tab adds sites up and checks that what field stations send, repeaters relay and bases receive actually meet. A static page with no server: state lives in the browser and in share links. The base station builder (build.html) goes deeper on a receiving base running RPi ALERT: how it fits together physically and in the code, which computer keeps up with how many channels, the SDR mounting, a bill with price ranges, lead times and suppliers, and the build steps.

status.summary: Prices re-checked in November 2026: each part is what one costs from an Australian shop with it in stock (else the cheapest way to get one, and when), and every bill — configurator, builder, trial — adds each shop's delivery once and clearance on an overseas order over A$1,000. The Pi 5 4 GB is A$249 in stock (A$178 was a back-order price); the RFI COL54 collinear is A$3,218 at Techwave, not the A$650 guessed; the RTL-SDR Blog V4 is end of life, so the V3 is the builder's stick. The builder and the Mallow trial rate every computer on RPi ALERT 0.17 and 0.19, with the Luna SL1680 and the Raspberry Pi range beside the Verdin AM62s.

components.name: Hardware catalogue

components.name: ALERT equipment and software
components.what: ERT-A2, Campbell and HSE units, encoders and base-station software — where the sibling repositories are cited.

components.name: Configurator page
components.what: Configurator: Sites, Network, Parts catalogue and How it works, behind one menu shared by every page; state in localStorage and share links.

components.name: Base station builder

components.name: Network check
components.what: Adds sites up by quantity and checks field stations, repeaters and bases meet on protocol and path.

components.name: Publishing
